prompt: Implement support for soft deletion of verification policies. Deleted policies should no longer be selectable for new sessions but must remain available for historical verification records. Update tests and documentation.

Create an endpoint for publishers to invalidate an active session before verification completes. Return 204 on success, 404 if the session does not exist, and 409 if the session has already been completed. Update tests and documentation.
spec_yaml:
task_id: invalidate-session-endpoint
summary: "POST /v1/sessions/:id/invalidate invalidates an active session before verification completes"
depends_on: ["stage-3-session-lifecycle-api"]
local_goals:
  - id: L1
    description: "POST /v1/sessions/:id/invalidate returns 204 on success for existing active session"
    verification:
      type: http
      method: POST
      url: http://localhost:3000/v1/sessions/{session_id}/invalidate
      headers:
        Authorization: "Bearer {test_token}"
      expect:
        status: 204
  - id: L2
    description: "POST /v1/sessions/:id/invalidate returns 404 if the session does not exist"
    verification:
      type: http
      method: POST
      url: http://localhost:3000/v1/sessions/{nonexistent_session_id}/invalidate
      headers:
        Authorization: "Bearer {test_token}"
      expect:
        status: 404
  - id: L3
    description: "POST /v1/sessions/:id/invalidate returns 409 if the session has already been completed"
    verification:
      type: http
      method: POST
      url: http://localhost:3000/v1/sessions/{completed_session_id}/invalidate
      headers:
        Authorization: "Bearer {test_token}"
      expect:
        status: 409
  - id: L4
    description: "Update tests to include new endpoint and scenarios"
    verification:
      type: cli
      command: "pnpm test --filter=@verified-attention/api -- --testPathPattern=session-invalidation"
      expect:
        exit_code: 0
  - id: L5
    description: "Documentation for the /v1/sessions/:id/invalidate endpoint is updated"
    verification:
      type: file_exists
      path: apps/api/docs/paths/v1/sessions/{session_id}/invalidate.yaml
      expect:
        exit_code: 0
global_goals_refs: ["G5", "G13"]
context:
  language: TypeScript
  framework: Express
  orm: Prisma
  test_framework: Vitest

prompt: Implement a POST endpoint for submitting evidence. Accept JSON with type, sessionId, and payload. Validate payload per evidence type. Return 201 with the new evidence object. Handle missing fields with 422. Add integration tests.
spec_yaml:

summary: "POST /v1/evidence submits evidence with validation"

      headers:

      body:

        sessionId: "{{session_id}}"
        payload: { timestamp: 1620000000000, duration: 5000 }
      expect:
        status: 201
        json_schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            id: { type: string }
            type: { const: "E-VISIBLE" }
            sessionId: { type: string }
            payload: 
              type: object
              properties:
                timestamp: { type: integer }
                duration: { type: integer }
              required: [timestamp, duration]
          required: [id, type, sessionId, payload]
  - id: L2

    verification:
      type: http
      method: POST
      url: http://localhost:3000/v1/evidence
      headers:
        Authorization: "Bearer {test_token}"
      body:
        type: "E-VISIBLE"
        payload: { timestamp: 1620000000000, duration: 5000 }

        status: 422

prompt: Implement rate limiting on all public API endpoints using configurable per-client quotas. Return 429 when limits are exceeded and include Retry-After headers. Ensure limits are covered by integration tests.
spec_yaml:
task_id: rate-limiting-public-api
summary: "Implement rate limiting on all public API endpoints with configurable per-client quotas"
local_goals:
  - id: L1
    description: "Add rate limiting middleware to Express app"
    verification:
      type: cli
      command: "pnpm test --filter=@verified-attention/api -- --testPathPattern=rate-limit-middleware"
      expect:
        exit_code: 0
  - id: L2
    description: "Configure rate limits for public API endpoints"
    verification:
      type: file_exists
      path: "apps/api/src/middleware/rateLimit.ts"
      expect:
        content: |
          import { RateLimiterRedis } from 'rate-limiter-flexible';
          const rateLimiter = new RateLimiterRedis({
            storeClient: redisClient,
            keyPrefix: 'rl',
            points: 100, // max requests per windowMs
            duration: 60 * 60 * 24, // milliseconds - how long to keep records of requests in memory
          });

          export default rateLimiter;
  - id: L3
    description: "Integrate rate limiting middleware into public API routes"
    verification:
      type: cli
      command: "pnpm test --filter=@verified-attention/api -- --testPathPattern=rate-limit-integration"
      expect:
        exit_code: 0
  - id: L4
    description: "Return 429 status code when rate limit is exceeded"
    verification:
      type: http
      method: GET
      url: http://localhost:3000/public-endpoint
      headers:
        Authorization: "Bearer {test_token}"
      expect:
        status: 429
        json_schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            message: { type: string }
          required: [message]
  - id: L5
    description: "Include Retry-After header in rate limit response"
    verification:
      type: http
      method: GET
      url: http://localhost:3000/public-endpoint
      headers:
        Authorization: "Bearer {test_token}"
      expect:
        status: 429
        headers:
          Retry-After: { type: string }
